versions.changelog:
Initial public release of work-productivity-skill-vetter-workflow-helper.

- Provides practical workflow, checklist, and implementation support for Skill Vetter-style tasks with validated demand on Clawhub.
- Supports agent users, skill authors, and maintainers in fixing bugs, improving reliability, hardening setups, and creating adjacent skills.
- Emphasizes local-hardware friendly outputs (scripts, checklists, templates) over cloud-only approaches.
- Includes a structured workflow with clear validation and success criteria for outputs.
- Triggered by common keywords and example requests related to productivity, vetting, and reliability improvements.
